overall: The AG found the Commission violated the Open Meeting Law by creating insufficient April 25 minutes that failed to summarize discussion or record minority views; no other violation was found, and the Commission was ordered to amend the minutes within 30 days.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the chair improperly deliberated outside a posted meeting while drafting a proposed finding on a JMS Notice of Intent.
allegations.key_passage: the Chair did not improperly deliberate outside of a posted meeting when he communicated with Commissioner Abodeely, Commissioner Sampou, the Conservation Administrator, or legal counsel as these were not communications between or among a quorum of the Commission.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the minutes of the April 25 hearing on the JMS Notice of Intent were insufficient and did not accurately record the discussion.
allegations.key_passage: Although the bullets provide some information about issues that were discussed, overall, the minutes fail to summarize the discussions that occurred.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a commissioner lacked authority to revise draft minutes; the AG addressed whether the Open Meeting Law regulates who may revise minutes.
allegations.key_passage: we note that the Open Meeting Law does not speak to who has authority to revise meeting minutes.

allegations.summary: Complaints raised a possible subcommittee formed by the chair and two commissioners drafting the finding.
allegations.key_passage: we find no evidence that the Commission created a subcommittee.

allegations.summary: Complaints and further-review requests raised additional issues not in the original complaints or not constituting Open Meeting Law violations.
allegations.key_passage: The complaints and requests for further review raise additional issues that we decline to review because they either do not, even if true, constitute violations of the Open Meeting Law or were not raised in an original complaint first filed with the Commission.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
Within 30 days of receipt of the determination, amend the minutes of the April 25 meeting to include sufficient detail summarizing the discussions that occurred
remedy_passage: We order the Commission's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution that a determination by our office of a similar violation in the future may be considered evidence of an intent to violate the Open Meeting Law. Additionally, we order the Commission, within 30 days of receipt of this determination, to amend the minutes of its April 25 meeting to include sufficient detail summarizing the discussions that occurred.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
